name: Homewood

dates.note: The node says begun 1801 and gives 1808; Wikipedia says construction began in 1801 and was mostly finished by 1808 while its infobox prints 'Built 1801'; the HABS data pages are extracts of Charles Carroll of Carrollton's letters of 30 January and 12 February 1801 about the house to be built.

refs.title: Homewood (Charles Carroll Jr. Mansion), North Charles & Thirty-fourth Streets, Baltimore, Independent City, MD
refs.note: The survey number is printed on the addendum cover ('HABS MD-35 HABS MD,4-BALT,1-'); the 1930s running head OCRs as 'MBS No. MD-36 Page 1' and 'HABS No. MD-35 Page 2'. Wikipedia's external links, read the same day, give '180 photos, 34 measured drawings, 6 data pages, 10 photo caption pages'.
The item id is the path segment of the data PDF actually fetched (found by a loc.gov search that returned the tile.loc.gov path); the landing page itself was not opened.

quotes.text: EXTRACTS FROM LETTER YJRITTEN BY CHARLES CARROLL OF 4-- &/u~T CARROLLTON TO HIS SOW, CHARI&S CARROLL, JR., REGARD- j . im THE BUILDING OP HOMEWOOD. January 30, 1801 Respecting the plan of your house to be built on Homewood, we will discourse at large when you and Harriet pay me a visit, "which I suppose will be in a little time after Mrs. Cat on's return. That house with the out^-houses will I am confident greatly exceed $10,000 and that is the utmost sum which must be laid out in buildings on Homewood.
